why: Design Reference is intended to represent one design/product composition, not an entire carousel containing multiple products.
Leaving the bundling in place contaminates future pattern frequency, theme evidence and preference/design assessment attribution.
The five boundary moves are supported by source-account/product continuity, not weak visual similarity alone.
The correction is recoverable if performed transactionally with a pre-write DB backup, exact before/after manifests and no deletion of raw evidence.
safe_method: Create timestamped canonical DB backup and record pre-write SHA-256.
Run read-only impact audit over design_reference, design_reference_image, preference evidence, assessments, pattern/theme relations and synthesis/observation tables before mutation.

Preserve original REF-000003 and REF-000004 keys for one surviving group each where semantically least disruptive; create new reference keys for the additional groups rather than renumbering existing references.
Move only the exact five high-confidence cross-boundary assets listed above.

For any reference-level historical relation whose meaning cannot be unambiguously assigned after a split, do not guess: preserve provenance but mark/quarantine it for review rather than copying it to every child reference.
Do not delete image observations, raw source evidence or user-signal history.
Recompute only deterministic linkage/status outputs; do not invent new pattern/theme/preference relations.
Validate foreign keys, integrity, row-count deltas, replay/idempotency, canonical fingerprints and full tests before commit.

user_decision_required.option_A_recommended: Authorize the HIGH_RISK canonical regroup correction described above, then proceed with safe additive semantic imports and full validation.
